question: List Head and Neck Nivolumab trials where overall follow‑up exceeded 21 months.

gemini.answer: This SQL query retrieves the NCT, author, year, and PubMed ID for all head and neck cancer clinical trials involving Nivolumab with an overall follow-up duration exceeding 21 months.
gemini.raw:
```json
{
  "sql": "SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\" FROM public.\"clinical_trials\" WHERE \"cancer_type\" ILIKE '%HNSCC%' AND \"ici_name\" ILIKE '%Nivolumab%' AND \"follow_up_duration_overall_months\" > 21",
  "answer": "This SQL query retrieves the NCT, author, year, and PubMed ID for all head and neck cancer clinical trials involving Nivolumab with an overall follow-up duration exceeding 21 months.",
  "assumptions": ""
}
```
